us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: State Department reduces staffing at four Middle East embassies over Iran threats
bullets: The State Department cited increased threats from Iran against U.S. personnel.
Four U.S. embassies in the Middle East are affected by staffing reductions.
The move follows intelligence warnings amid heightened regional tensions.

articles.title: Trump administration sues over possible Democratic win in Alaska Senate race
bullets: The administration moved to block a possible Democratic victory in Alaska.
The dispute comes days before the November 3 midterm elections.
The case adds to legal fights surrounding congressional control.

articles.title: Trump revives talk of military intervention in Cuba at South Florida rally
bullets: Trump said U.S. warships could stop in Cuba after returning from the Middle East.
He linked the idea to forcing political change in Cuba.
The remarks came during a campaign rally in South Florida.

articles.title: Trump questions Paris NFL game amid civil unrest and planned protests
bullets: Trump said the NFL could have postponed the Steelers-Saints game in Paris.
The State Department issued a security alert for Saturday protests.
Paris has faced unrest after recent street demonstrations.

articles.title: Inflation data, earnings and Fed meeting loom for U.S. economy
bullets: A key inflation update is due during a busy economic week.
Consumer confidence data is expected to show continued weakness.
Major earnings reports may clarify AI spending and household demand.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Melania Trump brokers planned humanitarian ceasefire in occupied Oleshky
bullets: A ceasefire is planned for the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky.
The pause is intended to allow aid delivery and evacuations.
The report came in an AP news summary on October 24.

articles.title: IAEA says plutonium leak at Vienna-area lab was contained
bullets: A small amount of plutonium leaked at an ageing IAEA laboratory.
The radioactive contamination was contained to a storage area.
The U.N. watchdog said no one was injured.

articles.title: China reports steady fiscal revenue growth through first three quarters
bullets: China’s general public budget revenue reached about 17.23 trillion yuan.
The figure covers the first three quarters of 2026.
The report cited newly released official data.

articles.title: Global focus turns to central banks and AI earnings in markets week ahead
bullets: The Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan are set to announce policy decisions.
Investors are watching Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft earnings.
AI capital spending remains a central market theme.

articles.title: Seven killed in Jordan church shooting, Indian outlets report
bullets: Gunmen opened fire inside a church in Jordan.
Reports said seven people were killed and 28 were injured.
The story was among top global headlines in Indian news roundups.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: AP investigation raises alarm over police shootings of alleged cow smugglers
bullets: AP found police in Uttar Pradesh shot hundreds of suspects in similar encounters.
Many cases involved Muslim men accused of cow smuggling.
Activists say the pattern is spreading to nearby BJP-run states.

articles.title: Takeaways detail alleged impunity in India cow-smuggling police shootings
bullets: AP said critics describe the shootings as extrajudicial justice.
The cases are tied to cow protection laws and religious politics.
The investigation focused on India’s most populous state.

articles.title: IndiGo Delhi-Chennai flight returns to bay after bomb threat
bullets: The IndiGo flight received a threat message on Friday afternoon.
The aircraft returned to the bay at Delhi airport.
Security checks were conducted after the threat.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu student dies after alleged caste and food-choice bullying
bullets: A Class XI Dalit student in Coimbatore allegedly died by suicide.
Reports cited caste-based harassment and bullying over beef eating.
The case appeared in October 24 India news archives.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh courts ₹9,625 crore in tech investments
bullets: The proposals include data centres and lithium-cell projects.
The investment push was listed among October 24 India headlines.
The projects highlight state efforts to attract technology manufacturing.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and themes

articles.title: U.S. stocks fall as rising oil prices pressure Wall Street
bullets: Major U.S. indexes declined in Friday’s session.
AP said rising oil prices weighed on equities.
The move capped a volatile week for markets.

articles.title: CrowdStrike leads cybersecurity gains after global website vulnerability warnings
bullets: CrowdStrike rose 8.3%, according to Axios.
Cybersecurity stocks gained after warnings about vulnerable websites.
The move contrasted with broader AI-stock anxiety.

articles.title: AI rally faces pivotal test from earnings wave and Fed meeting
bullets: Reuters said investors face a critical week for the AI-led rally.
Major AI players are due to report earnings.
The Federal Reserve meeting adds another market test.

articles.title: Tech selloff deepens, hitting hedge fund returns
bullets: Reuters reported a fresh tech reckoning hurt global hedge funds.
Major strategies posted their worst day since the COVID-era rout.
The pressure followed weakness in technology shares.

articles.title: Comfort Systems USA slides despite better-than-expected results
bullets: Comfort Systems USA was cited as the biggest mover in a weekend market brief.
Shares fell after a leadership change.
The company still reported better-than-expected results.

articles.title: Netflix tops earnings estimates while revenue matches expectations
bullets: Netflix reported third-quarter earnings of 87 cents per share.
Revenue was $12.9 billion, in line with analyst expectations.
The company said engagement remained healthy after 2026 price increases.

articles.title: AT&T raises 2026 earnings outlook after results beat estimates
bullets: AT&T reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter results.
The company raised 2026 EPS guidance to $2.40.
Telecom shares remain pressured by SpaceX wireless competition concerns.

articles.title: Abbott plans to spin off nutrition business
bullets: Abbott plans to create an independent publicly traded nutrition company.
Axios reported the plan in a corporate deal roundup.
The move would separate a major consumer-health business line.

articles.title: Blackstone and Warburg Pincus prepare IntraFi sale process
bullets: Blackstone and Warburg Pincus hired Morgan Stanley and Guggenheim.
The firms are exploring a sale of fintech company IntraFi.
Reuters said the deal could fetch about $10 billion.

articles.title: Potential Tesla-SpaceX tie-up draws attention as historic corporate deal
bullets: Axios said the potential transaction would be history’s largest corporate tie-up.
The idea remains tied to long-running Musk-company speculation.
The report highlighted rising investor focus on mega-cap consolidation.

articles.title: Chinese hacker used AI agents to target more than 100 company websites
bullets: AI agents attempted attacks on more than 1,200 websites, Tom’s Hardware reported.
More than 100 company websites were breached or targeted.
Deere and SharkNinja were among names mentioned in the report.

articles.title: Chinese tech giants reportedly place $35 billion in Nvidia GPU orders
bullets: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent reportedly ordered over 3 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs.
The chips are designed to comply with export restrictions.
Reports said only a fraction of orders may be fulfillable.

articles.title: Global website vulnerability warnings lift cybersecurity focus
bullets: Axios said warnings highlighted vulnerable websites worldwide.
CrowdStrike led gains among cybersecurity stocks.
The story underscored demand for defensive software after AI-aided attacks.

articles.title: PHP Foundation says it is under-funded with one full-time staff member
bullets: The PHP Foundation’s director said the organization is under-funded.
The foundation reportedly has only one full-time staff member.
The issue appeared in October 24 technology headlines.

articles.title: Google Health 5.11 update improves Pixel Watch activity tracking
bullets: The update was listed among widely reported tech headlines.
Google Health 5.11 adds smarter activity-tracking features.
The story appeared in October 24 headline roundups.
